Name: Willow Sky Ranch
Description: Family-run 75-acre ranch on the Willow City Loop with an oak-shaded ceremony site, an indoor hall and lodging for 20.

Name: Grand Oaks Ranch
Description: Private 22-acre ranch booked by the weekend, with a farmhouse and six silo homes sleeping 56 and a poolside cocktail hour.

Name: Contigo Ranch
Description: Ranch north of town with historic cabins and modern cottages for guests, and longhorns and Highland cattle on the land.

Name: Hoffman Haus
Description: Inn a few blocks from Main Street with a garden ceremony site, a reception hall in an 1840s tobacco barn and 22 rooms on site.

Name: Becker Vineyards
Description: Estate winery near Stonewall with a covered pavilion facing the sunset for up to 300 and the smaller Lavender Haus for about 100.

Name: Barons CreekSide
Description: Cabin resort on 26 acres with two creeks and a vineyard, hosting weddings and elopements outdoors among the vines.

Name: The Riverhill Mansion
Description: Early-1900s mansion on a private country club, with ceremonies by the water, on the lawn or inside; the banquet hall seats 150.

Name: Y.O. Ranch Hotel
Description: Western-themed hotel with over 11,000 sq ft of event space, a ballroom for up to 600 and in-house catering.

Name: Inn of the Hills
Description: Hotel and conference centre with a 20-foot-ceilinged ballroom for up to 600 and smaller rooms from 10 guests.

Name: Roddy Tree Ranch
Description: Small-wedding site on a 50-acre ranch, with an arch on the Guadalupe River bank and a part-covered pavilion with bar and kitchen.

Name: Spinelli's
Description: All-inclusive venue built around a century-old rock chapel, with a dining hall, dance hall, gardens and two guest houses.

Name: Camp Comfort
Description: Restored 1860s landmark on Cypress Creek, now a small hotel, with an 1870 social hall, a creekside lawn and an outdoor stage.

Name: Mayan Dude Ranch
Description: Family-run dude ranch since 1951 on 348 acres along the Medina River, with lodging and indoor and outdoor event spaces.

Name: River Yurt Village
Description: Glamping site on 21 acres by the Medina River: a covered pavilion, an optional air-conditioned hall, and yurts sleeping 40 in the package.
